title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly remove white-space characters from the current Text/String (leading, trailing and all) in AL
summary: This post explains four methods to remove whitespace characters from text strings in AL: TrimStart for leading spaces, TrimEnd for trailing spaces, Trim for both leading and trailing, and DelChr for all whitespace. It includes working code examples showing each method in a test page.
key_points: TrimStart() removes only leading whitespace characters
TrimEnd() removes only trailing whitespace characters
Trim() removes both leading and trailing whitespace in one call
DelChr() can remove all whitespace characters from anywhere in the string
Each method has specific use cases depending on which whitespace needs to be removed

quotes.text: Removes all leading occurrences of a set of characters specified in an array from the current Text object.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains what TrimStart does, essential for understanding when to use this method

quotes.text: Returns a new Text in which all leading and trailing white-space characters from the current Text object are removed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes Trim's dual functionality, useful for the most common whitespace removal scenario
